faqLeft.q: What engine does the Jaguar F-Type P450 use?
faqLeft.a: The F-Type P450 uses the AJ133 — a 5.0-litre supercharged V8 from Jaguar's Gen III AJ-V8 family, shared with the R and SVR variants.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Jaguar F-Type P450 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £6,500. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my F-Type P450?
faqLeft.a: All F-Type P450 models use the AJ133 V8. Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact spec before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild AJ133 F-Type P450 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, tensioners, guides and the water pump as standard on every AJ133 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used F-Type P450 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my F-Type P450 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an F-Type P450 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most F-Type owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
